title: SyncCycleSucceeded.v1
description: Emitted when the sync cycle completes successfully. Carries the eventsPushed/eventsPulled counts and durationMs that drive the /system Sync tile.

cycleId.description: Matches the cycleId on the corresponding SyncCycleStarted event.
cycleId.markdownDescription: Matches the cycleId on the corresponding SyncCycleStarted event.

eventsPushed.description: Outbox items pushed in this cycle.
eventsPushed.markdownDescription: Outbox items pushed in this cycle.

eventsPulled.description: Events pulled from the server in this cycle. Always 0 until pull is implemented.
eventsPulled.markdownDescription: Events pulled from the server in this cycle. Always 0 until pull is implemented.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the cycle, in milliseconds.
durationMs.markdownDescription: Wall-clock duration of the cycle, in milliseconds.
